compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN+ (IN_POS) whereas TLV9001IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VEE pin (GND vs V-).
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN- (IN_NEG) whereas TLV9001IDBVR assigns IN+ (IN_POS) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: LMV321IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) whereas TLV9001IDBVR assigns IN- (IN_NEG) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VCC pin (VCC+ vs V+).

parameter_matrix.note: Op-amps (compensated push-pull) and comparators (uncompensated open-collector) are NOT drop-in interchangeable.
Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.
Confirm total supply span (V+ - V-) stays within recommended limits.
Exceeding Vs,abs causes immediate gate-oxide or junction breakdown.
Closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth scales as f_-3dB = GBWP / Acl.
Controls large-signal full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak) or comparator switching speed.
Lower Vos minimizes DC error in current-shunt and sensor bridge amplifiers.
CMOS/JFET pA-class inputs avoid offset voltage drops across high-impedance (>100 kΩ) sensors.
Multiply by channel count for total IC standby current draw.
RRIO prevents clipping on low-voltage 3.3 V single-supply ADC buffers.
Higher CMRR rejects common-mode noise; lower voltage noise improves SNR.
Important when driving heavy resistive loads or high supply rails.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Soldering TLV9001IDBVR onto a LMV321IDBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV321IDBVR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=RR vs TLV9001IDBVR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.
engineering_verdict: LMV321IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV9001IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Key datasheet deltas: device type is opamp (push-pull) vs opamp (push-pull), supply limit is 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.14), max Vos is 7 mV (p.7) vs 1.6 mV (p.17), input bias current is 15000 pA (p.7) vs 5 pA (p.17), and Iq/ch is 130 µA (p.7) vs 60 µA (p.18). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.7), thermal margin (θJA 232.9 vs 232.9 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
